# leptos_aria

> Headless accessible components for Leptos, ported from React Aria with the Radix/shadcn primitive surface completed. No styles ship; state is exposed as `data-*` attributes for Tailwind v4. A shadcn-style CLI copies styled wrapper components into your project.

Install the library, install the CLI, add components:

```
cargo add leptos_aria
cargo install leptos_aria_cli
leptos-aria add button
```

## Docs

- [Tailwind v4 guide](https://ifiokjr.github.io/leptos_aria/tailwind.html): styling states with `data-[state=open]` variants and `@custom-variant` blocks, plus the full data-attribute contract
- [CLI guide](https://ifiokjr.github.io/leptos_aria/cli.html): `init`, `add`, `diff`, `build`, `leptos-aria.json`, theming, and hosting your own registry
- [Components](https://ifiokjr.github.io/leptos_aria/components.html): every styled registry component with install command, usage, and source
- [Registry index](https://ifiokjr.github.io/leptos_aria/r/registry.json): the shadcn-schema registry the CLI reads; each item is at `r/<name>.json`
- [Porting roadmap](https://github.com/ifiokjr/leptos_aria/blob/main/PORTING.md): every upstream hook, utility, and component with its crate
- [API docs](https://docs.rs/leptos_aria): the facade crate on docs.rs
- [Full documentation](https://ifiokjr.github.io/leptos_aria/llms-full.txt): every document above in one file

## The data-attribute contract

Every interactive component exposes its state so styling stays external:

- `data-state`: `open`/`closed` (Modal, Popover, Tooltip, AlertDialog, HoverCard, ContextMenu, Accordion), `checked`/`unchecked` (Switch), `on`/`off` (ToggleGroup), `selected` (Calendar, Tabs, ListBox), `loaded`/`fallback` (Avatar)
- `data-disabled`, `data-dragging`, `data-is-dragging`, `data-current`, `data-orientation`, `data-action`, `data-focused`, `data-expanded`

Tailwind v4's built-in `data-[...]` and `aria-*` variants target these directly with no plugin.

## Component surface

Interactions: usePress, useFocus, useFocusWithin, useHover, useFocusable, useFocusRing, useKeyboard, useLongPress, useMove, useDrag/useDrop, useScroll, useDismiss, useModal, FocusManager, useAutofocus.

Components: Button, AnchorButton, CustomButton, ToggleButton, ToggleGroup, Switch, Form, TextField, TextArea, SearchField, NumberField, OneTimePasswordField, Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup, Slider, ComboBox, SelectBox, ListBox, Menu, MenuTrigger, ContextMenu, Menubar, Tabs, TagGroup, Toolbar, Tooltip, Popover, Modal, AlertDialog, Dialog, HoverCard, Calendar, DatePicker, DateField, DateRangePicker, TimeField, FileTrigger, Grid, Table, Tree, Meter, ProgressBar, Toast, DropZone, DraggableItem, Link, Breadcrumb, Heading, Text, VisuallyHidden, Disclosure, Accordion, Pagination, ScrollArea, Separator, AspectRatio, Avatar, ColorField, ColorArea, ColorSlider, ColorWheel, ColorSwatch.

## Registry CLI

A shadcn/ui-style CLI. `leptos-aria init` writes `leptos-aria.json`, the theme CSS variables, and the `cn` helper. `leptos-aria add <name>` copies a Tailwind-styled component into `src/components/ui` with its dependencies. `list`, `view`, and `diff` read the registry, and `build` turns your own `registry.json` into a hostable registry. Items are served at `https://ifiokjr.github.io/leptos_aria/r/<name>.json` in shadcn's registry-item schema.
